## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION: Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; weak overall participation with pockets of strength in Tech and Healthcare. Confirmation: (1) very weak sector breadth (2/11) and (2) major divergence across large caps (several large names displaying 1W/1M mismatch), so trim beta and await clearer confirmation.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leading: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND. Energy has strong names but inconsistent breadth: MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication clearly lagging: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND. Utilities/Real Estate also soft versus recent highs.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors represented in Top 5); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large caps show 1W/1M mismatch (e.g., MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION; JNJ (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY) — treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed but with leaders: AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth is limited (Tech is one of only two positive sectors today), so momentum names can outperform while overall participation remains shallow.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials under pressure: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Weak (part of 9/11 negative sectors), monitor for further dispersion before re-adding cyclical exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing relative resilience but mixed internals: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Positive (Healthcare one of two positive sectors) but several large names are RECOVERY—watch for follow-through.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given CAUTION and the narrow participation, favor selective exposure to ABOVE TREND names in Tech and Healthcare (e.g., AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak Financials and Communication (e.g., BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed — refrain from broad shifts until breadth recovers.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND — momentum continuation candidate; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/upgrade follow-through; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND — sector strength. BEARISH: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.67%) — leaders may extend gains; Technology (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +1.83%) — watch AI/semis. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -6.95%) and Financials (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) — risks from sentiment and earnings.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND — watch break above near-term highs for re-acceleration; AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND — monitor 1M pullback support for continuation; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — watch for 1W follow-through to confirm deeper weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
TMO (+60): Thermo Fisher — strong demand; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. MPC (+60): Marathon Petroleum — upgrade/earnings beat; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND — price confirming. INTC (+50): Intel Terafab partnership boost; INTC (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment aligns with strong 1M performance.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BAC (-80): Bank of America — bond loss headlines; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NFLX (-50): Netflix downgrade; NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. CHTR (-45): Charter Spectrum troubles; CHTR (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -15.94%) BELOW TREND — strong confirmation of weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow participation and conflicting large-cap signals. AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND and TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND and NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND show clear weakness. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across big names and mixed news sentiment (notably strong negative headlines on BAC and CVS) — monitor for breadth improvement before expanding exposure.
